mapper.insert: INSERT INTO datasource (name, db_type, host, port, database_name, username, password, remark, pool_min_idle, pool_max_size, pool_idle_timeout_sec, pool_max_lifetime_sec, pool_conn_timeout_sec, uid) VALUES (#{name}, #{dbType}, #{host}, #{port}, #{databaseName}, #{username}, #{password}, #{remark}, #{poolMinIdle}, #{poolMaxSize}, #{poolIdleTimeoutSec}, #{poolMaxLifetimeSec}, #{poolConnTimeoutSec}, #{uid})
mapper.update: UPDATE datasource SET name = #{name}, db_type = #{dbType}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, database_name = #{databaseName}, username = #{username}, password = #{password}, remark = #{remark}, pool_min_idle = #{poolMinIdle}, pool_max_size = #{poolMaxSize}, pool_idle_timeout_sec = #{poolIdleTimeoutSec}, pool_max_lifetime_sec = #{poolMaxLifetimeSec}, pool_conn_timeout_sec = #{poolConnTimeoutSec} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, db_type, host, port, database_name, username, password, remark, pool_min_idle, pool_max_size, pool_idle_timeout_sec, pool_max_lifetime_sec, pool_conn_timeout_sec, create_time, update_time FROM datasource ORDER BY id
